title: AI Overview Capture Registry — EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 v12.559 — 1001 semantic addresses, 1193 captures, 2026-06-07 to 2026-11-04
creator: Trace, Orin
description: Versioned snapshot of the AI Overview Capture Registry (EA-WG-CAPTURES-01) at v12.559, its thousand-and-first address, continuing the deposit chain from v6.0 through v12.167 (#1676), which it supersedes; every earlier edition points forward to it. A longitudinal instrument for recording dated machine-mediated reception events: what composition layers make of a named entity when asked for it at a specific semantic address, on a specific date, in a specific authentication state. 1001 semantic addresses carry 1193 captures across 104 dates; 1176 carry a verbatim transcript and 484 a frame; 907 carry the historical PER scalar, at a mean of 0.429 (0.506 at v12.167), and 1171 carry a dimensional PER under rubric v1.1. Surfaces: Google AI Overview 745, ChatGPT across its recorded labels 278, Google AI Mode 21, Grok 9, Perplexity 9, Bing Copilot 6, Claude 3, Qwen 3, Bing AI Overview 2, Google Knowledge panel 2, nine single-capture surfaces, and 106 whose surface is undetermined or unresolved. The core data travels as one bundle with its SHA-256, the data files are attached individually as frozen, and the 485 capture frames are manifested at their canonical paths. Known defects are recorded as data and left unrepaired.
substrate: AI-assisted (substrate). Snapshot assembled, counted and written in session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) under MANUS (Lee Sharks) direction, from the canonical store at v12.559. The captures themselves were taken by the operator on the surfaces named in each record.
methodology: Each capture records the exact issued string, the surface, the date, the authentication state, the evidence class (paste, frame, or both), the returned source strip rendered as chips with each chip's relation to the archive (archive-controlled, authored surface, third party), a verbatim transcript where obtainable, and the finding. Surfaces are taken from operator attestation, with the frame as corroboration; a session is logged where it began. Match type and Provenance Erasure Rate are recorded per capture, never per address; the PER scalar is derived from its four-unit vector at seating, and the dimensional PER is scored against the target's atom set under rubric v1.1, or recorded as pending with its reason. A capture enters by source engagement in composition; a later non-engagement at an address already seated enters as a longitudinal observation of that address. Intake adds and is safe; repair touches an existing record and runs in its own mode. Each batch of intake is kept with the pastes as received, the operator's message and the script that authored each capture, in which every quotation and figure a finding rests on is asserted against its source before anything is written. Counts in this record are computed from data/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01.json at v12.559 by rebuild/capture-registry/snapshot-v12.559/stats.py.
falsification_conditions: Any capture is falsified by a rerun at the same address, surface, authentication state and date that returns materially different composition, which is why the exact issued string and the rerun URL are recorded. The snapshot is falsified if the attached bundle's SHA-256 does not match, or if any manifested file's SHA-256 does not match the file at its stated path. A PER score is falsified by a source strip, or a set of retained markers, inconsistent with the recorded value; a dimensional score by an atom marked present whose evidence is absent from the transcript.

wiki_article:
**AI Overview Capture Registry — EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 v12.559** is a versioned snapshot of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's longitudinal reception instrument, deposited under Dr. Orin Trace on 4 November 2026 at the registry's thousand-and-first semantic address. It supersedes v12.167 (#1676), and every earlier edition points forward to it. It records 1001 semantic addresses carrying 1193 dated captures across 104 dates, spanning 7 June to 4 November 2026.

The registry documents what machine composition layers make of a named entity when asked for it at a specific semantic address, on a specific date, in a specific authentication state. Each capture records the exact issued string, the surface, the evidence class, the returned source strip with each source's relation to the archive, a verbatim transcript where obtainable, a match type and a Provenance Erasure Rate. 1176 captures carry a transcript and 484 a frame; 907 carry the historical PER scalar, at a mean of 0.429, and 1171 a dimensional PER under rubric v1.1.

**The citable unit is the capture — one surface, one semantic address, one date.** Each address has its own page and, since 27 October 2026, its own position in the shared AXN ledger; each observation carries an AXN sealed with its analysis and measures.

Between v12.167 and this edition the instrument added dimensional PER (written 19 October, re-read under rubric v1.1 on 20 October, standard at intake from 29 October), derived the PER scalar from its vector at seating, minted AXNs for captures, and widened its surfaces: ChatGPT from 167 captures to 278, Google AI Mode from 12 to 21. The count declared and the count held agree at 1193, correcting v12.167's 813 against 811. The core data bundle, the data files and a manifest of 492 files are attached; known defects, among them a stale top-level defect summary and two frames referenced and not held, are recorded as data.
